description: This PHP class defines the WeightClass model for an OpenCart admin module, handling CRUD operations related to weight classes in the application's database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving weight class data and descriptions.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Model class for managing weight class data and descriptions in the database within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addWeightClass
methods.description: Creates a new weight class record in the database and adds its descriptions, returning the new record's ID.

methods.name: editWeightClass
methods.description: Updates an existing weight class record and its descriptions in the database.

methods.name: deleteWeightClass
methods.description: Deletes a weight class record and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getWeightClass
methods.description: Retrieves a specific weight class record including its description for the current language.

methods.name: getWeightClasses
methods.description: Retrieves multiple weight class records, optionally filtered by language, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalWeightClasses
methods.description: Counts the total number of weight class records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific weight class in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific weight class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all weight class descriptions corresponding to a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description for a specific weight class in a particular language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific weight class across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all weight class descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByUnit
methods.description: Retrieves weight class descriptions matching a specific unit for the current language.
